blocks.title: Define and predict
blocks.text: Divide and conquer breaks a problem into smaller instances, solves them, and (where relevant) combines results.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: Binary search repeatedly discards half of a SORTED array. It is an example of reducing to one subproblem rather than solving both.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Merge sort divides into halves and combines them in sorted order. Dividing alone is not enough; correctness depends on valid preconditions and combining.
